Maya: Heads-up — I opened a tiny docs PR to update the SDK snippets for streaming + pagination after the retry/backoff API rename. Need reviewers who can confirm examples still work in py/ts/go. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452

Ethan: Thanks — will take a look. Note: we changed `stream_iter` -> `stream` and added `max_retries` defaulting to 3. Also the TS generator is now async iterable.

Priya: Quick checklist: 1) streaming examples show resumable cursor, 2) pagination example uses `page_token` not `cursor`, 3) retry/backoff example uses `exponential_backoff` helper.

Maya: Yup — PR includes three files to tweak: examples/py/streaming.md, examples/ts/pagination.md, examples/go/retries.md. I simplified the py snippet but want someone to sanity-check the import lines.

Ethan: Py snippet looks like:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=\"$REDWOOD_KEY\")

async for chunk in client.stream('gpt-small', prompt='summarize this', max_retries=2):
    print(chunk.text)
```

Ethan: Should update to `async for chunk in client.stream(...)` instead of `for chunk in client.stream_iter(...)`.

Maya: Good call. TS snippet I changed to async iterator too, example:

```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });

for await (const token of client.stream('gpt-small', { prompt: 'summarize this' })) {
  process.stdout.write(token.text);
}
```

Priya: For Go we still have to show the pagination helper — the SDK exposes `ListResponses(ctx, opts)` that returns a pager with `Next()` and `PageToken()`. Example I suggested:

```go
pager := client.ListResponses(ctx, &ListOpts{PageSize: 50})
for pager.Next() {
  resp := pager.Value()
  // handle resp
}
if err := pager.Err(); err != nil {
  // handle error (retries built-in)
}
```

docs-bot: Auto-linker found broken reference in examples/ts/pagination.md line 42 -> replaced with https://redwood.dev/sdk/streaming

Maya: Great. Can @Ethan and @Priya please add short runbook notes in the PR description about expected runtime behavior (latency, retry counts) so support can triage any questions?

Ethan: Will add a 2-line note about `max_retries` and exponential backoff jitter.

Priya: Added a short blurb about pager semantics in the Go example and a note that page tokens are opaque strings.

Maya: Awesome — once CI green and both of you approve I'll land and then follow up to backport the change to archived guides. :shipit:

Ethan: Approving now. :thumbsup:

Priya: LGTM

Maya: Thanks team — merging in 10 if no objections.

Leo: ping — I'll drop a short entry in the release notes about the snippet naming changes (stream_iter -> stream).

Maya: Perfect, thanks!
